test_command: No test runner. Use `npm run build` as the primary gate, plus `node --check <file>` for edited CommonJS server files (server/routes/orders.js, server/setupSupabase.js, server/migrateData.js) and `node --check api/index.js`.
verification_instructions: 1) Run `npm run build` from the project root; it must compile with zero errors — fix any errors. 2) Run `node --check` on each edited server/* and api/index.js file. 3) Do NOT start the dev server (long-running). 4) Grep-confirm the new identifiers are present where expected (presence check only; build is the real gate).

environment_constraints: Do NOT run the dev server. Edit directly in the workspace (no worktree). `portable-app/` holds STALE copies of server/* and is neither built nor deployed — do not edit it. Two live backends (api/index.js for Vercel, server/* for Render/local) MUST stay in sync for any order-field mapping change.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING in the repo (only inside node_modules). Follow existing code style: api/index.js is condensed one-liner style; server/routes/orders.js uses multi-line mapOrder/snakeOrder; Dashboard.jsx is a large single component. Commit locally on the branch; never push.
key_patterns: Order field naming: client camelCase (e.g. paymentRemarks) <-> Supabase snake_case (payment_remarks). New field: followUpType <-> follow_up_type, label 'Follow Up Direct/Sir'. The main Orders table renders each cell via getCellValue(order, col.key); inline-editable cells (see akhilPoints branch) do axios.put('/api/orders/:id', {field:value}) then fetchOrders(). PUT body is translated by snakeOrder() in BOTH backends. Config-driven tables (handleExport, print report, handleDeletedExport) iterate the column-config arrays and use col.label as header, so adding the column to the config + getCellValue makes it flow automatically; only HARD-CODED tables (ALL_DELETED_COLS, the daily percentReceived blocks, the two import mappers) need manual edits. Column insertion is ALWAYS immediately before the paymentRemarks/Payment Remarks entry, keeping header+data cell counts matched. Payment Update Report tables list PAYMENTS (p.remarks), not orders — EXCLUDED from the new column. The Follow Up edit permission uses the EXISTING per-column permission grid (None/View/Edit) via canEditColumn(key) (Dashboard.jsx ~220; userPerms = user.columnPermissions ~194; getAllowedColumns ~215). Adding followUpType to the shared ALL_COLUMNS makes the permission grid and both pickers show it automatically. Do NOT add any canFollowUp/can_follow_up boolean right — it was explicitly dropped by the user. Refresh infra: GET /api/app-version returns {version} from app_settings key app_version (exists in api/index.js ~185; ABSENT in server/* — must be added). POST /api/force-refresh (admin) sets app_version to Date.now(). AuthContext.jsx has hardReload() scoped inside the daily-13:40 useEffect (must be lifted to shared scope) and the Dashboard Force-Refresh button uses localStorage key oms_app_version.
